name: Gulf Cooperation Council
officialName: Cooperation Council for the Arab States of the Gulf
aliases: Cooperation Council for the Arab States of the Gulf

flag.description: A green field with the council's circular emblem in the centre: a black ring of gold Arabic script around a hexagon framing a map of the Arabian Peninsula.
flag.symbolism: The hexagon stands for the six member states and the map for the peninsula they share; the script reads 'In the name of God' above the council's name.

hook: The GCC sets a map of the Arabian Peninsula inside a six-sided frame, one side per member, in a black ring on green.
trivia: The council was founded in Abu Dhabi on 25 May 1981 by Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates.
In May 2011, the council's 30th anniversary, the six members agreed to fly its flag alongside their national flags.
